title: Tuning perovskite recombination by hydrogen interstitial oxidation state
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,22481-22487
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02305C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yong Huang, Rongkun Zhou, Xiaoqing Chen, Wencai Zhou, Hui Yan, Zilong Zheng
Hydrogen interstitial in perovskites show oxidation-state dependence; H0i can introduce a deep state enabling nonradiative decay, while Cl passivates the trap, suppresses nonradiative coupling, and restores the carrier lifetime from 0.1 ns to 87 ns.
